description: This file implements the 'PulseAudioSinkType' class and 'PulseAudioSink' class, which manage PulseAudio audio sink creation, configuration, and operation, including thread management, stream handling, volume control, and callback handling for audio playback on Linux systems.

classes.name: PulseAudioSink
classes.description: Represents an individual PulseAudio sink, managing stream initialization, volume, playback rate, and data writing.

classes.name: PulseAudioSinkType
classes.description: Manages PulseAudio context, main loop, thread, and creation/destruction of PulseAudio sink instances.

methods.name: PulseAudioSink::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PulseAudio stream with specified parameters.

methods.name: PulseAudioSink::WriteFrameIfNecessary
methods.description: Handles writing audio frames to the PulseAudio stream if needed.

methods.name: PulseAudioSinkType::Initialize
methods.description: Sets up PulseAudio context, main loop, and starts the audio thread.

methods.name: PulseAudioSinkType::Create
methods.description: Creates a new PulseAudio sink instance.

methods.name: PulseAudioSinkType::Destroy
methods.description: Destroys a specified PulseAudio sink instance.
